blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — ACT Teachers party-list Rep. Antonio Tinio has joined calls to investigate the proposed joint venture agreement (JVA) between the South Cotabato II Electric Cooperative (Socoteco II) and a private firm, saying that Congress should ascertain whether consumer welfare remains as the priority. In a statement on Monday, Tinio said that he is now a co-author of House Resolution (HR) No. 1401, which asks the House of Representatives to start a probe of Socoteco II’s possible JVA with Ignite Power and Energy Corporation due to allegations of irregularity and unfairness in the deal.
